reconciliation.dedupBasis: the 12 named entries come from disjoint per-round osAudit diffs (one entry per directory name); the 8 anonymous entries cover exactly the runs whose per-round records are unrecoverable (evidence files overwritten by later same-name runs, or processes killed before their audit). No directory can be in both sets: a named record requires a completed round audit, and all completed-round audits that survived are enumerated.

osSnapshotCapabilityBoundary.canProve: process list (pgrep), listening ports (connect probes / lsof), and temp-directory NAMES present at audit instants; per-round newTempCaches diffs name every directory a completed round created and failed to remove
osSnapshotCapabilityBoundary.cannotProve: directories created and removed entirely between two audits; directory NAMES for processes that died before their audit (only class and count are derivable); resources outside the audited prefixes; whether an external actor touched the temp root between audits
osSnapshotCapabilityBoundary.consequence: cleanup of the 12 named entries is name-level verified; cleanup of the 8 anonymous entries is count-level verified only, hence CLEANED-IDENTITY-UNVERIFIED
